integrity: The analytic dimension proof uses disjoint first-return similarities; exact-rational finite cylinders are supporting checks only. The generating function and first-entrance phase law follow from affine full-branch conditioning.
scientific_limitations: Strict interior Khan–Rajan parameters, integer p>=3, real m>1, Lebesgue-uniform initial conditions. Dimension covers the set never entering the specified cyclic periodic intervals. Not a general theorem for arbitrary chaotic interval maps; independent audit and exhaustive priority verification have not been performed.
title: Exact exceptional-set dimension and first-entrance laws in eventually periodic chaotic interval maps
